description: This file defines the 'CustomWeightBasedShippingQuote' class, which implements the ShippingQuoteModule interface. It provides functionality for calculating shipping options based on package weights and custom regional configurations within a shipping module of an e-commerce system.

classes.name: CustomWeightBasedShippingQuote
classes.description: Implements a shipping quote module that calculates shipping options based on package weight and regional configurations.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the shipping module configuration. Currently not implemented.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves and parses custom shipping configuration settings stored as JSON in merchant configurations.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Calculates available shipping options based on package weights, regional settings, and configuration.
